name: Sable Coast Concord

name: Glass Kingdoms of Orinth
description: Fractured princely realms where glassworks fund espionage and border wars.

description: Settlements along the Redwater River; old ruins surface after seasonal floods.

name: The Starfall Archive
description: Scholars catalog meteoric relics; rival colleges sabotage each other’s expeditions.

description: Post-war valley where village pacts with forest patrons keep the dead quiet.

description: Criminal consortium running protection, smuggling, and private arbitration.

name: Kestrel & Cinder

description: A desert marked by compass anomalies; maps lie and caravans vanish overnight.

description: Noble regency council ruling during a decades-long tempest season.

name: Eidolon Canalworks
description: Industrial waterways with union politics, sabotage, and haunted lockgates.

description: Student-led mystery arcs in a rivalrous arcane academy.

name: The Ember Pact
description: Early draft world that merged into another campaign; kept for record only.
